messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Deal Desk <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>; Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>; Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>; Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-08-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: PrismeTech renewal — request for executive waiver (details + recommended concession)

Team,

I need an expedited executive waiver for PrismeTech's annual renewal. Quick context: they are a strategic healthcare analytics customer (~$1.2M ARR) who experienced a 3-week ingestion outage in Q2. Renewal window closes 8/22 and procurement is pressing for a concession or they will evaluate competitive bids.

What I'm asking for: an approval to offer a one-time retention package comprising:
- 30% one-time discount on year 1 (applied to current list pricing)
- Reset the contract term from 12 -> 24 months with standard annual escalators thereafter
- Add a temporary SLA credit: 5% uptime credit applied to Q4 invoice; and a ticket-priority routing promise for their integration team for 90 days

Why: the account has 20% YoY growth in footprint and is close to signing a cross-product POC (Embeddings + Text Gen) — losing them will materially impact our health metrics for the region and open the door for a competitor that has already offered a deeper discount.

Financials (high level):
- Current committed ARR: $1.2M
- Proposed impact year 1: ~$360k discount (one-time) -> net ARR recognized $840k for year 1 but with renewal floor via 24-month term
- Estimated gross margin hit (one-time): ~22% of ARR

Recommended authorization level: Exec sign-off required due to magnitude of discount and term non-standardness. If approved, I'll propose the concession as a conditional make-good tied to a 24-month commitment and a joint customer success QBR cadence.

Attachments: renewal summary + signed SOW + price comparison.

Request: can someone please confirm an executive decision by end of day Monday (8/16) so I can finalize the mutual action plan with Laura Jenkins.

Thanks,
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Account Director, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>; Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>; Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>; Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-14T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PrismeTech renewal — request for executive waiver (details + recommended concession)

Rishi,

Thanks for the summary — reviewed the attached pdf. A few clarifying questions before I escalate formally to finance/execs:
1) Is the 30% discount applied to list or post-volume tiers? Please annotate the sheet for clarity.
2) Are we prepared to commit to a 24-month minimum MRR floor if they under-consume after month 6? We need to avoid open exposure without a consumption guarantee.
3) Can legal accept the SLA credit language as a billing credit (not service-level change)? Procurement will push for contractual SLA edits otherwise.

If you can answer inline, I will assemble a one-page memo for Vivek and pull this into the sign-off queue. Also flagging that approvals >25% require VP+ sign-off per policy — so this will need your exec shepherding.

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Deal Desk, Sales Operations
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@prismetek.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Jenkins <laura.jenkins@prismetek.com>; procurement@prismetek.com
Date: 2026-08-14T13:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal follow-up and proposed renewal terms

Rishi,

Appreciate the transparency. From PrismeTech's side our primary asks to close this week are:
- A concession that recognizes the outage impact (discount or invoice credit)
- Longer term to stabilize budgeting (24 months ideal)
- A written SLA commitment and a named escalation engineer for the integration phase

We can sign quickly if Redwood confirms the proposed package in writing by COB 8/16. Happy to circulate a short addendum once you confirm the structure.

Regards,
Daniel Park
Head of Legal, PrismeTech
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>; Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>; Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>; Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-15T09:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PrismeTech renewal — request for executive waiver (details + recommended concession)

Team,

Thanks for the concise brief. I agree this is high-risk to lose and recommend an approval path with guardrails. Approve the following on an interim basis pending final legal/finance sign-off:
- Approve up to 30% one-time discount (applied to year-1 invoice) conditional on a signed 24-month term with a 10% minimum consumption floor for months 7-24.
- SLA credit: allow a single 5% invoice credit for Q4 (written as billing credit) and a named escalation engineer for 90 days (operational note only; do not change core SLA language).
- Require a finance-approved make-good clause: if consumption falls below the 10% floor in any rolling quarter after month 6, Redwood may invoice the difference to true up to list price for that quarter.

Vivek will present this to COO for final sign-off if legal confirms the paper can be handled via addendum and finance signs off on the make-good. Neha — please generate the memo with the numbers and margin impact; Karthik — please prepare a tight addendum template that keeps SLA language as-is but documents the credit mechanism.

I want the final decision routed by EOD 8/16 so Rishi has time to close with PrismeTech.

-Vivek

Subject: Re: PrismeTech renewal — request for executive waiver (details + recommended concession)

Thanks all — confirming next steps and outcome per Vivek's interim approval:
1) Rishi to send conditional addendum (30% one-time discount year 1 + 24-month term) to PrismeTech by 8/16 COB, subject to legal/finance make-good clause.
2) Neha to circulate the finance memo and margin impact; Karthik to produce addendum draft by tomorrow morning.
3) Vivek to loop in COO for final sign-off if legal/finance have no objections.

Laura/Daniel — we will send the conditional addendum now and mark it as contingent on final internal sign-off; please confirm you'll countersign within 48 hours if accepted.

Rishi
